Apply the 25/25/50 Rule in Every Trade

This rule helps you manage risk and optimize entries:

🔹 First Entry (Limit or Aggressive): Deploy 25% of your risk.
🔹 If Drawdown Occurs: Deploy another 25% once price moves against you.
🔹 When Market Reverses & Closes Above Entry: Deploy the remaining 50% of your risk.

✅ Why This Works:

👉Smaller Losses: If the trade fails, you lose only half your intended risk.
👉Better Positioning: If the trade works out, your entries are layered for a better average price.
👉Psychological Edge: You're not all-in from the start, reducing stress and improving decision-making.

Can you make 10% consistently with big capital… like $3M, $4M, $5M?”

Short answer: NO.

Because trading is not fixed income.
It’s an unpredictable, psychological, and risk management game.

⸻

I get a lot of requests to manage funds with expectations like:
“Give us 10% every month.”

That’s not how markets work.

Statistically, it’s unrealistic.
And anyone promising that consistently… either doesn’t understand trading, or is misleading you.

⸻

Can 10% happen in a month?
Yes.

Can it happen every month?
No.

As a trader, you don’t think month-to-month…
You think year-on-year.

⸻

The ones who come with these unrealistic expectations…
Either lose their capital…
or destroy themselves mentally chasing it.

⸻

Understand this clearly:

Trading is not about forcing returns.
It’s about managing risk and surviving long enough to compound.

🥷 Agree ? Let me know @swappyict

A lot of people think putting all money into trading is the way to grow fast.

That’s exactly how you lose everything.

⸻

My fund allocation is always diversified:
 • 25–30% in trading (active income)
 • 30% in physical assets (real estate, etc.)
 • 20% in bonds / money market (capital protection)
 • 20% reserved for high-risk plays (to multiply capital)
